EXPERIENCE · DECEMBER 2022 — AUGUST 2025

CAD Design Engineer · Imaging Engineer PSI

Zimmer Biomet · Bogotá, Colombia

Patient-specific medical engineering

At Zimmer Biomet, I worked in the Patient Specific Instruments (PSI) team, supporting the development of customized surgical solutions based on patient medical imaging data.

My main responsibilities involved transforming medical imaging information into accurate 3D models and patient-specific surgical guides, following established engineering workflows and validation procedures.

Main responsibilities

  • 3D CAD Design: Creation and modification of patient-specific anatomical models, surgical guides, and implants using specialized CAD workflows.
  • Medical Imaging: Processing and reconstruction of CT data to support accurate anatomical representation and surgical planning.
  • Digital Surgical Planning: Support for landmark identification, model validation, and planning workflows using specialized engineering software.
  • Process Standardization: Preparation of technical documentation and support for workflow improvements and consistency.
  • Technical Training: Onboarding and guidance for new engineering team members, sharing technical knowledge and workflow procedures.

This experience strengthened my skills in precision engineering, 3D modelling, medical imaging, technical validation, and multidisciplinary collaboration.
